DECISION (EU) 2023/1534 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 26 July 2023

CELEX: 32023D1534

Whereas:

(1) Decarbonisation targets for energy and industrial sectors require reformed ETS allowance allocations.

Article 1

The market stability reserve intake rate shall be set at 24% for year 2024 and onwards.

Article 2

This Decision enters into force on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal.
